name: @shieldbattery/broodrep
description: WebAssembly bindings for the broodrep StarCraft replay parser

scripts.build: pnpm run build:node && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('pkg-node/package.json', { force: true })"
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('pkg/package.json', { force: true })"
scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('pkg', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('pkg-node', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
